title: Kolkata on a Budget: The Smart Traveler's 2026 Guide
metaDescription: Experience Kolkata without breaking the bank. Budget accommodation, cheap eats, and free activities for the savvy traveler.
excerpt: Kolkata does not have to be expensive. With the right strategy, you can experience the best of Kolkata while keeping costs surprisingly low.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
There is something about Kolkata that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those traveling on a budget to Kolkata, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Budget Accommodation

- Hostels and guesthouses offer affordable beds without sacrificing location or cleanliness
- Vacation rentals can be cheaper than hotels, especially for groups or longer stays
- Homestays provide authentic experiences at a fraction of hotel prices
- Camping and glamping options for outdoor enthusiasts visiting Kolkata

![Budget travel in Kolkata](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1603813507806-0d311a6eecd1?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Eating on a Budget

Supermarkets and convenience stores in Kolkata are perfect for stocking up on breakfast items and snacks.

## Free and Cheap Activities

- Free walking tours with knowledgeable local guides
- Public parks, beaches, and hiking trails with no entry fees
- Free museum days and cultural events throughout the year
- Window shopping and people-watching in vibrant neighborhoods
